extraction_notes: Curves were digitized from the plotted traces in p. 3, Fig. 1, Fig. 2, and Fig. 5 at labeled grid positions; no curve interpolation was used between sampled trace positions.
The datasheet has no typical VGS(th) value. The threshold limits are 0.7 V minimum and 1.5 V maximum at VDS = VGS and ID = 250 uA.

Additional transcribed table values not represented by the strict schema include IDSS = 0.5 uA maximum at VDS = 50 V, VGS = 0 V; IGSS = +/-100 nA maximum at VGS = +/-20 V, VDS = 0 V; and gfs = 0.12 S minimum at VDS = 10 V, ID = 0.22 A.
Switching maxima are tD(on) = 5 ns, tr = 18 ns, tD(off) = 36 ns, and tf = 14 ns at VDD = 30 V, ID = 0.29 A, RG = 6 ohm, VGS = 10 V.

Maximum-rating and package data include PD = 0.3 W at Ta = 25 degC, RthetaJA = 417 degC/W at steady state, and TJ/TSTG = -55 to +150 degC. No RthetaJC, gate-charge, or reverse-recovery specification is published.
The capacitance figure is a typical trace at the datasheet's stated 1 MHz test frequency; the tabulated Ciss, Coss, and Crss values are retained separately in specs.
The datasheet does not publish Qg, Qgs, Qgd, trr, or Qrr values.
